author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
For the April Dev Update Stream, the ESO Community Team and guests delve into some of the new features and adventures coming soon with Update 50 (currently on PTS) including dynamic encounters, veterancy, Thieves Guild content, and more.

For this show, the team will welcome the following developers:   
Associate Design Director Mike Finnigan (Dungeons and Encounters)
Associate Design Director Jason Barnes (Content and Quests)
Project Design Director, Combat & PvP Brian Wheeler

Dev Updates is a new series of ESO livestreams where the ESO Community Team and developers showcase and highlight some of the things they’ve been working on over the past month. If you’d like to get a first look at what's coming next to ESO, then you won’t want to miss this!
title: ESO Dev Updates Livestream—April 2026
